name: fmcsa-carrier-mcp
description: Vet US motor carriers and brokers from FMCSA open data: authority, insurance, OOS, safety.
long_description: For freight brokers, shippers and 3PLs vetting US motor carriers and brokers before tendering a load. USDOT/MC lookup, operating authority, insurance, out-of-service status, safety data and red flags, from FMCSA open data on data.transportation.gov (Socrata SODA API). No API key needed.

tools.name: lookup_carrier
tools.description: Look up one US motor carrier / broker / freight forwarder by USDOT number or MC/FF/MX docket number.

tools.name: search_carriers
tools.description: Search FMCSA-registered carriers/brokers by name (legal or DBA name, case-insensitive substring).

tools.name: check_authority
tools.description: Full compliance check of one carrier/broker: operating authority, insurance, orders, out-of-service, safety.

tools.name: red_flags
tools.description: Heuristic fraud/risk screen for one carrier or broker (double-brokering, identity theft, chameleon carriers).
